errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.phone: Use a Cambodian number, for example 012 345 678.

auth.sentTo: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to verify your email, then sign in.
auth.verified: Email verified. You can sign in now.
auth.forgotLead: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotNoEmail: Joined with a link and have no email? Ask the Owner of your business for a reset link.
auth.linkSent: If this email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.passwordSaved: Password saved. Sign in with your new password.
auth.inviteNew: New to ModernStock? Create your login:
auth.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dot, dash. You sign in with it.
auth.inviteClosed: This invitation was already used, cancelled, or has expired. Ask for a new link.
auth.linkInvalid: This link is not valid or has expired.

account.noBusinessLead: A business is your shop. You can add branches, products and staff after.
account.archivedLead: Restore one to open it again. It counts towards your businesses limit again.

setup.title: Set up {{business}}
setup.branchNameHint: Your shop's name or area, for example Toul Kork.
setup.branchLead: Where you sell. You can add more branches later in Settings.
setup.moneyLead: The rate turns dollars into riel at the POS. You can change it every day.
setup.starterLead: Units and categories that fit your kind of shop. You can change or add to them any time.
setup.samples: Add {{n}} sample products to try the POS
setup.samplesHint: They have no stock. Deactivate them in Products when you no longer need them.
setup.readyLead: Check what we will set up, then finish.
setup.marketNote: We also add a "Market" supplier, for things you buy at the market.

roles.permissionsLead: Tick what people with this role may do ({{n}} ticked).
roles.builtInNote: Built-in roles can't be changed. Duplicate one to make your own.

perm.product:manage: Add and edit products, categories, units, Excel import
perm.customer:create_pos: Add a customer from the POS
perm.purchase_order:manage: Create, order, cancel and close purchase orders
perm.bill:manage: Bills, supplier payments, returns and credits
perm.sale:create: POS sales, payments received, pay later within the credit limit
perm.sale:override: Go over the credit limit, discount above the limit
perm.sale:void: Void sales, returns and credit notes
perm.transfer:return_void: Return a transfer to sender, void a transfer
perm.report:view: Reports (what they show depends on the role)
perm.member:manage: Invite and manage members, roles and reset links
perm.sales_return:request: Ask for sales returns (an Owner or Manager approves)
perm.purchase_return:prepare: Prepare purchase returns (an Owner or Manager approves)

shell.trialEnding: Your Pro trial ends in {{days}} days. Choose a plan to keep going after it.
shell.branchReadOnly: This branch is read-only on your plan: you can look at everything, but not add new work.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.trialLead: Your trial ends on {{date}}. Nothing is deleted when it ends.
dashboard.noSales: No sales in the last 30 days.

comingSoon.title: Coming next
comingSoon.lead: This screen is designed in the prototype and will be built in the next step.
comingSoon.apiReady: The API for it is ready; see Swagger.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Add your first product.
products.skuHint: Left empty, it is made for you (P00001...).
products.baseUnitHint: Stock is counted in this unit, usually Piece.
products.reorderHint: Shows as low stock at or below this.
products.unitsLead: For example a box of 24 pieces, with its own barcode and price.
products.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? It disappears from sales; its history stays.
products.symbolHint: Short, for example pcs, box, kg.
products.branchPricesLead: A branch can sell at its own price. Leave a box empty to use the default price shown in grey.
products.branchReorderLead: Each branch can reorder at its own level. Leave a box empty to use the product's level shown in grey; 0 stops watching the product in that branch.

stock.title: Stock
stock.byBranchLead: Each branch's stock and its reorder level. A red number is at or below the level.

pos.title: POS
pos.empty: Scan a barcode or tap a product.
pos.khqrLead: Show the shop's KHQR code. When the money arrives, complete the sale.
pos.laterLead: The sale goes on {{name}}'s account as an invoice, paid later.
pos.needCustomer: Pick a customer to pay later.
pos.pickBranch: Pick the branch you sell in.
pos.estimate: Prices and VAT are checked again when the sale is saved.
pos.noRate: There is no exchange rate yet. Set today's rate first.
pos.rateStale: Today's exchange rate is not set yet: sales use the rate of {{date}}.
pos.heldLead: Sales put aside on this device. Resume one to finish it; the cart on screen is held in its place.
pos.heldDone: Sale held. Serve the next customer.
pos.heldFull: {{n}} sales are already held. Finish or remove one first.

partners.name: Name
partners.openingHint: What they owed before you started with ModernStock.
partners.openingHintSupplier: What you owed them before you started with ModernStock.

profile.lead: How your business shows on receipts, invoices and in the app.

branches.warehousesLead: Stock is kept per warehouse. One sells (POS, deliveries) and one receives goods.

members.name: Name
members.emailHint: Without an email, share the link (Telegram, QR code) yourself.
members.resetLead: Give this link to {{name}}. It works once.
members.qrLabel: QR code of the invitation link
members.qrLead: They can scan it with their phone camera.
members.branchesHint: They work only in these branches and pick between them in the top bar.

rates.lead: Today's rate turns dollars into riel on every sale. Each document keeps the rate it used.
rates.stale: Today's rate is missing; the last one is used.

tax.footerHint: For example: Thank you! Please come again.

rules.lead: How the POS rounds riel, what cashiers may do and how customers can pay.
rules.maxDiscount: Biggest discount a cashier may give (%)
rules.maxDiscountHint: Above this, a manager must approve.
rules.negativeHint: Off by default: a sale stops when the stock is not there.

appearance.lead: The color of the app for everyone in this business, and your own light or dark mode and rows.
appearance.ownHint: Any color but red or gray. It is made darker if white text on it would be hard to read.
appearance.darkened: Saved, a little darker so text on it stays easy to read

problem.invalid: Pick a color with the color picker.
problem.red: Red is kept for problems and warnings in the app. Pick another color.
problem.gray: This color is too gray to stand out. Pick a stronger one.

appearance.densityHint: Compact fits more rows of a list on the screen. Only for you.

billing.pastDueLead: Pay before {{date}} to keep your plan. After that the business moves to Free; nothing is deleted.
billing.invoiceWaitingLead: Pay it to start the plan.
billing.cancelled: Your plan is cancelled. It stays until {{date}}, then the business moves to Free.
billing.onFree: You are on Free. Extra branches are read-only and extra members are switched off until you subscribe. Nothing was deleted.

afterTrial.MONTHLY: After the trial: {{plan}}, {{price}} a month. The first invoice comes when the trial ends.
afterTrial.YEARLY: After the trial: {{plan}}, {{price}} a year. The first invoice comes when the trial ends.

billing.trialChoose: Choose a plan below to keep going after the trial. Without one, the business moves to Free; nothing is deleted.
billing.freeLead: Subscribe to a plan below to switch everything back on.
billing.paymentFailed: The payment failed: {{reason}}. The invoice is still open; try again.
billing.demoNote: Demo payment: no money is charged.
billing.noGateway: Online payment is not available yet.
billing.chosenToast: {{plan}} is chosen. The first invoice comes on {{date}}, when the trial ends.
billing.upgradeAsk: Upgrade to {{plan}} now? You pay only the difference for the days left until {{date}}. After that it renews at the {{plan}} price.
billing.downgradeAsk: Change to {{plan}} on {{date}}, at the end of this period? You keep your current plan until then.
billing.cancelAsk: Stop renewing? Your plan stays until {{date}}, then the business moves to Free. Nothing is deleted.
billing.cancelTrialAsk: Don't continue after the trial? On {{date}} the business moves to Free. Nothing is deleted.
billing.cycleToast: Saved. The change starts on {{date}}, at the end of this period.
billing.addonsLead: Add more without changing plan. You pay for the days left in this period, then each add-on renews with the plan.
billing.addonsNeedPlan: Add-ons need an active paid plan.
billing.addonLead: {{price}} each billing period, renewed with your plan. Today you pay only for the days left until {{date}}.
billing.addonRemoveAsk: Remove {{name}}? It stays until {{date}} and is not renewed.
billing.addonRemoveNowAsk: Remove {{name}}? It is not paid yet, so it goes now and its invoice is voided.
billing.transferLead: Send {{amount}} to this account from your bank app, then add a screenshot of the transfer. We check it and switch it on, usually within a working day.
billing.screenshot: Screenshot of the transfer in your bank app
billing.transferSent: Sent. We will check the transfer and let you know here.
billing.transferWaiting: We are checking your transfer for invoice {{number}}
billing.transferWaitingLead: This usually takes less than a working day. There is nothing else to do.
billing.keepTitle: What stays on with fewer places
billing.keepLead: When your plan allows fewer branches or members, the ones ticked here stay on. Other branches become read-only and other members are switched off. Nothing is deleted.

print.voidNote: This invoice is void. Nothing is owed on it.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.headerHint: Printed under the shop name, e.g. opening hours or a slogan.
receipt.showTin: Show the VAT TIN on receipts

methods.title: Payment methods
methods.lead: How customers can pay at the POS and for invoices.
methods.khqrHint: Your shop's KHQR from the bank app. The POS shows it for the customer to scan.

expiry.title: Near expiry
expiry.lead: Three windows for batches that expire soon. The first one warns on the dashboard, in alerts and in the daily Telegram summary; the expiry report shows each of them.
expiry.order: Each window must be longer than the one before
expiry.hint: 30, 60 and 90 days unless you change them.

archive.title: Archive this business
archive.lead: Archived, it leaves everyone's list and nobody can open it. Nothing is deleted: you can restore it from My businesses. Cancel a paid plan first.
archive.ask: Archive {{name}}? Its members lose access until you restore it. Nothing is deleted.

numbers.title: Document numbers
numbers.lead: The letters in front of each number, e.g. INV-202611-0001. Leave them as they are, or use your own.
numbers.twice: Each kind of document needs its own prefix.
numbers.hint: 1 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter. New documents use the new prefix; old numbers stay.

export.title: Export all data
export.lead: Everything in this business in one Excel file, a sheet each: products, stock, customers, sales, money, purchases and stock moves.
export.notInPlan: Exporting to Excel is part of the Basic and Pro plans.

docs.noLines: Add at least one product line.

adjust.title: Adjustment
adjust.qtyHint: Positive adds stock, negative takes it out.

purchase.quickLead: Bought at the market: save, receive the goods and pay in one step.
purchase.payLead: Pays the oldest bills first. Money left over is kept as an advance and pays the next bill.
purchase.advanceHint: Not used on a bill yet: it pays the next bill from this supplier.

sales.receiveLead: Paid by the customer; it pays the oldest invoices first. Money left over is kept as a deposit and pays their next invoice.
sales.depositHint: Not used on an invoice yet: it pays the next invoice of this customer.

expenses.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete {{name}}? If expenses use it, it is switched off instead.
expenses.categoriesLead: What your expenses are for. A new business starts with six.

counts.startLead: The count starts from the stock the system has now.
counts.postConfirm: Post {{number}}? Each difference changes the stock.
counts.searchPh: Find a product in the count
counts.productsHint: For example, the products on one shelf.
counts.blindHint: Counters don't see how many the system has. The differences show when the count is submitted.
counts.blindNote: Blind count: the system quantities show once the count is submitted.
counts.waitingNote: Submitted. The Owner or a Manager checks the differences and posts it.
counts.recounted: Their stock was taken again. Count them again.
counts.movedNote: Stock changed while counting (sold or received): {{n}}.
counts.movedHint: Sold or received after counting started: count it again.
counts.unknownCode: No product in this count has the barcode {{code}}.

lead.sales: Sales from receipts and invoices, before VAT and the whole-sale discount.
lead.gross-profit: Sales minus the cost of the goods sold, at their average cost when sold.
lead.profit: Gross profit minus the expenses of the period.
lead.customer-debt: What each customer owes now (amounts from before ModernStock included) and what is past due.
lead.supplier-debt: What you owe each supplier now, bills due within 7 days, and what is past due.
lead.stock-on-hand: What is in stock now and its value at average cost. Stock in transit is counted on its own.
lead.reorder: Products at or below their reorder level, with how much to order.
lead.expiry: Batches in stock that expire soon, and expired batches still in stock.
lead.count-differences: Where the counted quantity differed from the system in posted stock counts.
lead.abc: Products ranked by the value sold at cost: A makes the first 80%, B the next 15%, C the last 5%.
lead.losses: Stock lost in the period: adjustments by reason, short counts and damaged returns.
lead.slow-moving: Products in stock that have not sold for a while: money sitting on the shelf.
lead.cash-shifts: Closed cash shifts: the cash expected and counted in dollars and riel, and voided sales.
lead.vat: VAT collected on sales (returns taken off) and paid on purchases, month by month.
lead.purchases: Goods received from suppliers, less what went back.
lead.customer-statement: Every invoice, payment, credit note and refund of a customer, with the balance after each.
lead.supplier-statement: Every bill, payment, supplier credit and refund of a supplier, with the balance after each.
lead.eoq: How much to order at a time so that ordering and holding stock cost the least: √(2 × yearly demand × order cost ÷ holding cost).

reports.reorderRule: Order = enough for the delivery days plus {{cover}} days of sales (average of the last {{days}} days), keeping the reorder level as safety stock, minus what is on hand.
reports.excelPlan: Excel export is in the Basic and Pro plans.
reports.noShifts: No shifts closed in this period.
reports.pickCustomerHint: Choose a customer to see their statement.
reports.pickSupplierHint: Choose a supplier to see their statement.
reports.eoqHow: Yearly demand from the last {{days}} days of sales. Holding cost is a share of the average cost.

telegram.lead: Get yesterday's sales and stock news every morning in a Telegram chat or group.
telegram.daily: Daily summary at 07:00 (sales, profit and cash of yesterday)
telegram.expiry: Include batches that expire soon (the first near-expiry window in Sales rules)
telegram.noBot: This server has no Telegram bot yet, so Telegram can't be connected.
telegram.notInPlan: Your plan does not include Telegram messages, so nothing is sent.
telegram.step: Open the bot in Telegram and tap Start. For a group, choose the group: the bot joins it.
telegram.connectedLead: Messages go to this chat. Connect another one to replace it.
telegram.summarySent: Yesterday's summary was sent. Check Telegram.
telegram.instantLead: Sent straight away, not only in the morning summary.
telegram.shiftShort: A cash shift closes with less cash than expected
telegram.debts: Include customer invoices overdue, and supplier bills overdue or due within 7 days
telegram.approvals: Something waits for approval (adjustment, stock count, return)

import.badFile: This file could not be read. Use .xlsx or .csv.
import.leadProducts: Add many products at once from an Excel or CSV file: names, category, unit, price, barcode and a pack size.
import.leadStock: Put the stock you already have into a warehouse, with cost, batch and expiry. It is posted as one opening stock document.
import.columnsProducts: Columns: nameEn, nameKm, sku, barcode, category, unit, sellPrice, reorderLevel, leadTimeDays, trackExpiry (yes/no), packUnit, packFactor, packBarcode, packPrice. Only nameEn and sellPrice are needed; an empty SKU is made for you, a new category is added.
import.columnsStock: Columns: sku (or barcode), qty, unit, unitCost, batchNo, expiryDate. unitCost is the cost of one of that unit; expiryDate is needed for products that track expiry.
import.step3: Check the rows below, then import the ones that are ready.
import.empty: The file has no rows under the header.

alerts.EXPIRED: {{n}} expired batches are still in stock
alerts.RATE_MISSING: Today's exchange rate is not set yet
alerts.PAYMENT_DUE: A billing invoice is waiting to be paid
alerts.TRIAL_ENDING: Your Pro trial ends within 7 days
alerts.COUNTS_TO_APPROVE: {{n}} stock counts wait for your approval
alerts.RETURNS_TO_APPROVE: {{n}} customer returns wait for your approval
alerts.PURCHASE_RETURNS_TO_APPROVE: {{n}} supplier returns wait for your approval
alerts.TRANSFERS_LATE: {{n}} transfers in transit for over {{days}} days

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.lead: Demo controls move a business through its billing month in seconds. No money is charged.
admin.endTrialAsk: End the trial of {{name}} now? It gets its first invoice if a plan is chosen, else it moves to Free.
admin.renewAsk: End the billing period of {{name}} now? A renewal invoice is made (or it moves to Free after a cancel).
admin.expireAsk: Treat the 7 past-due days of {{name}} as over? Its plan expires to Free.
admin.suspendBusinessAsk: Suspend {{name}}? Its members can no longer open it. Nothing is deleted, and you can reactivate it later.
admin.reactivateBusinessAsk: Reactivate {{name}}? Its members can open it again.

account.name: Name
account.suspendAsk: Suspend {{name}}? They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you reactivate the account.
account.reactivateAsk: Reactivate {{name}}? They can sign in again.
account.verifyAsk: Mark {{name}} as verified without the email link?

transfer.noProof: The screenshot could not be loaded.
transfer.reasonPh: Shown to the owner, e.g. the amount does not match
transfer.rejected: Rejected. The owner sees the reason.

plans.lead: Prices and limits for new invoices. Empty limit = unlimited. Free always stays at $0.
plans.name: Name

settings.lead: New values apply from now on: to new trials, new businesses and new invitations.
settings.trialHint: Days of Pro a new business gets for free.
settings.maxHint: How many one person may create. Archived ones don't count.
settings.invitationHint: After this, the Owner sends a new invitation.
settings.announcementLead: A banner over every page of the app for everyone, e.g. planned maintenance. Each person can close it.
settings.announcementHint: Leave both empty for no banner. With one language only, everyone sees that one.

stats.revenueSub: Paid plans and add-ons, per month

image.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
image.wrongType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
image.tooBig: The picture is bigger than 2 MB.

print.proformaNotice: Proforma invoice: a request for payment before delivery. It is not a tax invoice; the invoice comes with the delivery.

accountPage.everywhereLead: Signs you out on every phone and computer, this one too. Use it if you lost a device or signed in on a shared one.
accountPage.everywhereAsk: Sign out on every device, this one too?

returns.title: Return items
returns.leadCustomer: Goods {{customer}} brings back. Good items go back to stock; damaged ones are recorded as a loss.
returns.leadWalkIn: Goods a walk-in customer brings back. They get their money back now.
returns.keptAsCredit: Otherwise it stays as the customer's credit, for their next invoices.
returns.waitingCustomer: Nothing has moved yet. Approving puts good items back in stock, makes the credit note and gives the money back as asked.
returns.waitingSupplier: Nothing has moved yet. Approving takes the goods out of stock and makes the supplier credit.
returns.requestNote: An Owner or Manager approves it. Nothing changes until then; the money is given back when it is approved.

customer.newLead: For a price correction: money you owe the customer back, used on their invoices or refunded.
customer.noOpen: This customer has no invoice to pay.

supplier.newLead: For a price correction: money the supplier owes you back, used on their bills or paid back to you.
supplier.noOpen: No bill from this supplier is waiting to be paid.

purchaseReturns.title: Return to supplier
purchaseReturns.lead: Goods going back to {{supplier}}. They leave stock from the batch they came in with.
purchaseReturns.refundNow: The supplier pays it back now
purchaseReturns.keptAsCredit: Otherwise it stays as credit for this supplier's next bills.
purchaseReturns.prepareNote: An Owner or Manager approves it. Nothing leaves stock until then.

orders.quotationLead: A price offer for the customer. It changes nothing until it is accepted and becomes a sales order.
orders.orderLead: What the customer ordered. Stock leaves and the invoice is made when it is delivered.
orders.pricesHint: Prices, VAT and the total appear as you add products.
orders.overLimit: The discount is above your limit. Ask the Owner or a Manager.
orders.deliverLead: Goods handed to {{customer}} now. Stock leaves and the delivery is invoiced at the ordered prices.

scanner.title: Scan with the camera
scanner.hint: Hold a barcode inside the frame.
scanner.denied: The camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings.
scanner.insecure: The camera only works when the app is opened over https.

labels.title: Barcode labels
labels.lead: Labels for A4 sticker sheets of 24 (3 × 8, 70 × 37 mm). In the print window, choose no margins.
labels.empty: Add the products to print labels for.
labels.missing: {{n}} of them have no barcode yet.
labels.askManager: Ask the Owner or Manager to give them barcodes.
labels.noneMissing: Every product already has a barcode.

docPhoto.receiptAdd: Add a photo of the receipt
docPhoto.invoiceAdd: Add a photo of the supplier's invoice
docPhoto.empty: No photo yet. Take a picture of the paper so it stays with this record.
docPhoto.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Big photos are made smaller first. Only people who can see this record see the photo.
docPhoto.removeConfirm: Remove this photo? The record stays as it is.

debit.title: Debit note
debit.lead: The customer owes more after an invoice: a price corrected up, a delivery charge… It is paid like an invoice.
debit.voidAsk: Void {{number}}? The customer will no longer owe it.

requests.lead: Ask another branch for goods. They make the transfer, or say why they can't.
requests.cancelAsk: Cancel {{number}}? The other branch will no longer see it as open.
requests.fulfilled: Transfer made from {{number}}: check it and send
